name: coc-zig-next
description: Zig support for coc.nvim: toolchain management, the Zig Language Server (zls) and editor integrations.
author: wongxy <xiyao.wong@foxmail.com>

zig.path.description: Path to the zig executable, or "zig" to look it up in PATH. Leave empty to install and manage zig automatically.

zig.libPath.description: Override the Zig library path. Resolved by the Zig compiler when unset.

zig.formattingProvider.description: How Zig formatting is provided: `off` disables formatting, `extension` invokes `zig fmt` directly, `zls` delegates to the language server.

zig.buildOnSaveProvider.description: How build on save diagnostics are provided: `auto` leaves it to the language server, `extension` runs `zig build --watch`, `zls` enables the language server's build on save, `off` disables it.

zig.buildOnSaveArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to `zig build` when running build on save. Use `--build-file` to override the build file.

zig.zls.enabled.description: Whether to use the ZLS language server: `ask` prompts once, `off` never starts it, `on` installs and starts it automatically.

zig.zls.path.description: Path to the zls executable, or "zls" to look it up in PATH. When set, no download happens.

zig.zls.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between coc and the ZLS language server.

zig.zls.enableSnippets.description: Enable snippet completions when the client supports them.

zig.zls.completionLabelDetails.description: Show the function signature in completion results. May improve readability in some editors when disabled.

zig.zls.semanticTokens.description: Level of semantic tokens. `partial` only includes information that requires semantic analysis and usually gives a better result thanks to the syntax file.

zig.zls.inlayHintsShowVariableTypeHints.description: Enable inlay hints for variable types.

zig.zls.inlayHintsShowStructLiteralField.description: Enable inlay hints for fields in struct and union literals.

zig.zls.inlayHintsShowParameterName.description: Enable inlay hints for parameter names.

zig.zls.inlayHintsShowBuiltin.description: Enable inlay hints for builtin functions.

zig.zls.inlayHintsExcludeSingleArgument.description: Don't show inlay hints for single argument calls.

zig.zls.inlayHintsHideRedundantParamName.description: Hide inlay hints when the parameter name matches the identifier, e.g. `foo: foo`.
Hide inlay hints when the parameter name matches the last token of a parameter node, e.g. `foo: bar.foo`.

zig.zls.warnStyle.description: Enable warnings for style guideline mismatches.

zig.zls.highlightGlobalVarDeclarations.description: Whether to highlight global var declarations.

zig.zls.skipStdReferences.description: Skip searching for references in the standard library. Improves lookup speed for functions in your code; renaming and go-to-definition keep working.

zig.zls.preferAstCheckAsChildProcess.description: Favor using `zig ast-check` instead of the builtin one.

zig.zls.builtinPath.description: Override the path to the 'builtin' module. Resolved automatically when unset.

zig.zls.buildRunnerPath.description: Specify a custom build runner to resolve build system information.

zig.zls.globalCachePath.description: Path to a directory used as zig's cache. Defaults to zls's own cache on the system.

zig.zls.additionalOptions.description: Additional config options forwarded to zls. Every property must have the format 'zig.zls.someOptionName'. There is no warning about unused or ignored options.
